sentences.text: 2  HC-KAR CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA
ORAL ORDER

The petitioner is before this Court calling in question the registration of a crime in Crime No.37/2025 for offences punishable under Sections 3(1)(r) and 3(1)(s) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and under Sections 506, 504, 384, 406 and 420 of the IPC.

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri. Ajay Kadkol T., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Sri. B.N. Jagadeesha,
learned
Addl. SPP appearing for respondent No.1, Miss. Anushree N.P., learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3. During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves and have filed a compounding application along with an affidavit.

The affidavit so filed reads as follows:
"1. I Dixit Praveen Bhai Patel, am the Petitioner in the above case.
I am conversant with the facts of the case NC: 2026:KHC:6891 HC-KAR and as such I am swearing this affidavit out of my own free will and volition.
2. I, Santosh Nagaraj, am the Second Respondent in the above case.
I am conversant with the facts of the case and as such I am swearing this affidavit out of my own free will and volition.

3. The subject matter of the case in Cr.No.37 of 2025 registered at Rajaji nagar Police Station, Bengaluru in CC No.1141 of 2025 pending on the file of the LXX Addl. City Civil And sessions Judge, (CCH 71), pertains to a civil dispute which was pending inter-se between the Petitioner and Second Respondent herein.

entities.text: LXX Addl. City Civil And sessions Judge, (CCH 71)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. The dispute between the Second Respondent and the Petitioner herein has been resolved amicably and as such all the other proceedings which were pending inter-se between the parties in respect of the charges mentioned in captioned petition have been laid a quietus to.
5. The Second Respondent does not wish to contest this matter any further in view of the amicable settlement having arrived at between the parties.
